description: Multiple residents on Oak Street received identical emails claiming to be from PG&E requesting immediate payment via gift card. The email contains a link to a spoofed login page at pge-billing-update.xyz.
Several package thefts reported at Maple Ridge Apartments over the past week. A resident captured doorbell camera footage showing the same individual taking packages between 2-4 PM on weekdays.

LocalCredit Union issued a notice that their member database was accessed by an unauthorized party on Feb 28. Approximately 12,000 accounts may have had names and email addresses exposed. No financial data was compromised.
Broken streetlight on the north side of Elm Park near the playground has been out for three nights. Multiple residents have expressed concern about visibility for evening walkers.

Door-to-door individuals claiming to represent a solar panel company are asking for Social Security numbers as part of a 'credit pre-qualification.' The company name does not appear in the state contractor registry.

IT staff at the Westside Public Library detected a rogue WiFi access point named 'Library_Free_WiFi_5G' mimicking the legitimate network. Users who connected may have had unencrypted traffic intercepted.
Fake parking meter QR code stickers were found on three meters along Main Street. Scanning the code directs users to a phishing site that collects credit card information.
A section of the River Walk Trail near mile marker 3 has significant erosion after recent rains. The guardrail is partially collapsed. Parks department has been notified but no repair date set.

Seniors at the Sunrise Center report receiving phone calls from someone impersonating Medicare, asking them to 'verify' their Social Security number to avoid losing coverage. This is a known seasonal scam.

A new SMS phishing campaign is circulating, claiming recipients have an unpaid toll and linking to a fake payment portal. The messages come from various short codes and use urgency language like 'pay within 24 hours to avoid penalties.'
